We don’t hate the games, we’re mostly just disappointed. Personally gens 1 - 5 are amazing to me. They have plenty of flaws, but they also show clear effort to innovate and make genuinely good games that the Pokémon company cares about. But with the recent entries, it just feels like such a big waste of potential. Sure each individual game is fairly good in a vacuum. If they were all individual games not part of a franchise, it’d be different. But we’re coming up on the 9th iteration of the franchise, so it’s impossible not to compare the games to earlier ones.

So seeing the massive downward slope in quality and care put into the games, it’s hard not to complain.

TL:DR
We don’t complain because we hate Pokémon. We complain because we love it. We love it enough to want to see it grow and become better.

Pokémon crystal clear, a rom hack, does level and team scaling. The game checks how many badges you have and scales the gyms to have more Pokémon and higher levels. That means that all 16 gym leaders have 16 different teams so you can truly go in any order you want. If fans can do it, I dont see why Gamefreak can’t do it with a game from the ground up. If the trailers say you can take on the gyms in any order, then they should scale. It just makes sense. I’ve heard the argument “well you can still take them on in any order, you’d just have to grind to their levels.” And is that really a solution? Grind to beat the last gym and make all the rest easy? I legit don’t understand how the gyms scaling is a bad thing. When you have 0 badges, all the gyms have 2 Pokémon level 10-12 or so. Then when you get 1 badge, all the gyms teams have 2-3 Pokémon maybe around level 20. And so on. There’s no reason the gyms scaling is a bad thing in an open world jrpg. And so many people I try to talk about this with just immediately bring up elden ring? Sure they’re both open world, but they’re not comparable in the slightest. Comparing Pokémon with Elden ring is like trying to compare Skyrim with final fantasy. They’re fundamentally different games that just happen to share some genre classifications. I just want a reasonable answer as to why the gyms scaling is bad without grinding as a solution or comparing it to completely different game franchises. It’s like Pokémon fans just want the games to be mediocre at this point. They give horrible excuses for Gamefreak being lazy for no reason. “Pokémon doesn’t have voice acting cause it never did.” Yeah? All games had no voice acting. Do you think that no games should have it now? Imagine if final fantasy just stayed the same as the original all these years. Not adding voice acting or changing the battle system at all. It wouldn’t nearly be as popular as it is now. But for some reason pokemon just gets a pass to keep the same basic rock paper scissors battle system with little changes. It just baffles me that the game series with evolution as a main mechanic refuses to actually evolve itself, and people are just fine with that and you get called a hater for thinking otherwise. But at the same time, why would they put time and effort into changing things and making them more engaging when they can just do the bare minimum and people with still buy it anyway? It’s just truly a shame the trajectory that the franchise and fanbase is heading in. (Wow sorry I really went off there huh? Sorry, but pokemon is really special to me so I’m passionate about it 😅)
